title: Composite haplotype tagging at MICA rs2596542 links cross-population signed-LD reversal to an HLA-B/HLA-C regulatory axis
description: Analysis scripts and metadata for rs2596542 carrier haplotype decomposition using 1000 Genomes Phase 3, GTEx v8 eQTL summaries, and LIRI-JP validation analyses. Controlled-access raw data are not redistributed.
